decision: exclude — no Atlas record (defunct legacy manufacturer; name-magnet conflation with ORG-000092 Ohio Rubber Group resolved by annotation, not a record)
rule_cited: Atlas creation rule (own-site or dated primary evidence of CURRENT operation required; an EPA/CERCLIS profile proves existence, not activity); SCHEMA §4.2 (a closed status requires status_date + status_source — the closure date is unsourced); AGENTS.md §3 (name-similarity matches are not identity)
notes: The Ohio Rubber Company, 3911 Ben Hur Ave, Willoughby, OH 44094 (Lake County; EPA ID OHD004222378). Rubber manufacturer est. 1893 (ORCO molded/extruded goods); taken over by Eagle-Picher Industries in 1952 and run as its Ohio Rubber division. No evidence of current operation found 2026-10-29 (H-8.5 pack): no own website, no current operating listing, trade press already calls it 'former' (Apr 2013), and 3911 Ben Hur Ave is currently occupied by DeMilta Iron & Metal (scrap-metal recycling; FMCSA carrier snapshot ACTIVE). The CERCLIS profile (Not on NPL; Deferred to RCRA Subtitle C; assessment completed 1995) documents a legacy site, not a living company. NOT the Ohio Rubber Group (ORG-000092, ecosystem.csv), the ACS Rubber Division trade association in Summit County — the similarity is a name magnet; do not match the two. Re-adjudicate if a sourced closure date surfaces (then: status=closed tombstone, option b) or current-operation primary evidence surfaces (then: Ring 1 record, option a).
